reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: The audience-facing draft contains no source paths, internal artifact IDs, slide/page locators, drafting commentary, or section roadmap. The two requested visuals appear as genuine figure placeholders at lines 24 and 38, not inline pseudo-diagrams.

source_fidelity.evidence: Verified against the named sources and traceability sidecar: WP4 Node-Level Deep Dives v2 supports 16/26/33 across 75 and the gap clusters; WP5 supports 74 terms and the platform-only glossary caveat, 8 domains and ownership boundaries, governance actors, and ratification/assignment before development; the governance technical specification supports validation, staged approval, and archiving; the business-objective source supports the phase-one institutional/specialist audience. It omits node codes, detailed subcategories, field lists, forms, activity procedures, and per-item requirements excluded by the contract.

headline_conclusion.evidence: The opening at lines 3-5 makes the governing conclusion explicit without reconstruction: the current deliverable is a logical blueprint linking the user-facing web structure to governed data, not an operating platform. Line 47 closes with the concrete institutional decisions required to make that blueprint implementable.

findings_over_process.evidence: The draft prioritizes the blueprint's decision value, user missions, content readiness, semantic/governance controls, and DCCE's required actions. References to the consultant are limited to identifying what was produced at lines 3, 15, and 30; no methodology, workshop chronology, or consultant workflow displaces the findings.
